nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
ERC20 token symbol, set to METOR in the MetaLinkOracle constructor.
ERC20 token name, set to 'MetaLink Oracle' in the constructor.
ERC20 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply, initialized to 1000000000000000000000000000 in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances of accounts.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking spending allowances.
pure helper adding two uints and requiring c >= a to guard against overflow.
pure helper subtracting b from a after requiring b <= a.
pure helper multiplying a and b and requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
pure helper dividing a by b after requiring b > 0.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function storing _newOwner into the pending newOwner slot.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and zeroes newOwner.
Token constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the deployer/pre-mine balance, then emitting Transfer.
constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
constant function returning the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the caller's allowance, updating balances and allowed.
constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance for spender and then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting all plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function performing an external ERC20 transfer of arbitrary tokens held by this contract to owner.
Untrusted caller address used for authorization checks, balance ownership and allowance keys.
External call from approveAndCall into spender's receiveApproval(address,uint256,address,bytes) with arbitrary data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token to an attacker-influenced token address.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply (Solidity 0.4.18, no SafeMath).

Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
Owned constructor takes the untrusted msg.sender as the initial owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership.

transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner slot.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.

Constructor writes the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor writes the pre-mined balance into the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to exclude the burn address.
totalSupply performs an unchecked uint subtraction that can underflow in Solidity 0.4.18.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances state mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the untrusted caller controls the source account.

Parameter tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
approve writes the allowed state mapping.

transferFrom updates the balances state mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed state mapping.

Parameter spender is the inner key in allowance.

approveAndCall writes the allowed state mapping.
approveAndCall executes an external callback into the caller-supplied spender contract.
Attacker-controlled data is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner state variable.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the arbitrary external contract to call.
Parameter tokens is the amount requested from the external ERC20.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract before returning.
